title: plugin-form: `MasterDetailForm` raises its save-success and save-error toasts under separate auto ids, so a refused save followed by a successful one shows both outcomes at once — the #7252 defect class, outside PR #7342's surface
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (session `session_01NRRumy89BYdW9ogbcdHTho`) from the out-of-scope finding the dev of PR #7342 (#7252) handed over; measured by that dev on `origin/main` `ebc05b4d6`, re-read by the seat on the same ref. Dedupe: semantic search returns #7252 (the parent, whose file surface excludes this file), #2278 (closed — two SUCCESS toasts on master-detail create, a different defect), #2252 and #3014 (closed, unrelated). No open card names `MasterDetailForm`'s outcome toasts. Control query hit.

## The defect

`packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` raises its two save outcomes as two separate callbacks on one save path:

- `handleSaved` → `toast.success(...)` at line 831;
- `handleError` → `toast.error(...)` at line 850.

Neither carries a sonner `id`, and nothing dismisses the previous attempt's toast when a new save starts. A save the server refuses leaves its error toast on screen; when the user corrects the input and saves again inside that toast's lifetime, the success toast lands beside it and the form ends on a screen asserting both outcomes — the #7252 defect exactly, on a renderer PR #7342 did not touch (its surface was the SDUI form renderer and the console's `FormPage`).

**Where it bites, for grading**: the console is masked — that host supplies `onSuccess`, and the built-in success toast is then deliberately skipped. Hosts that do not supply `onSuccess` (SDUI / embedded) get both toasts.

## The fix (one executable criterion)

The shape PR #7342 landed, applied here: one stable per-form id (`React.useId()`-scoped, e.g. `form-outcome:` + the id) shared by the success and the error toast in `MasterDetailForm`, plus `toast.dismiss(thatId)` at the start of each save attempt. A pin in the same family as `WizardForm.outcomeToastSupersede.test.tsx` (mock `@object-ui/components/ui/sonner`, the module the raiser reaches — a bare `sonner` mock from `plugin-form` intercepts nothing): refused save then successful save ⇒ the toast registry ends with exactly the success entry. Red on today's file, green after; ablation of the id makes it red again.

## Not in this card

- Toast durations (measured at 4000 ms on every form path; supersession is the whole fix).
- The console host (`onSuccess` path) — already masked, nothing to change.

Refs: #7252 · PR #7342 (the shape) · objectui#4190 (a refusal that must stay readable beside a confirmation — the one case that must NOT share the id).
